sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Baban Prasad, Advocate For the State : Ms. Nehala Sharmin, A.P.P.
------
Order No.03 Dated :17.02.2023 Instant petition has been filed for quashing the order dated 25.11.2022 whereby the order of issuance of process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. against the petitioner in connection with Hariharganj P.S. Case No.14 of 2022 under Section 323, 341, 504,
498A of the I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P. Act.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the petitioner is not absconding.
He has submitted to the authority of the Court pursuant to remedies under due process of Court.

Earlier he had filed A.B.P. before Sessions Judge-V, Palamau which was rejected and against order of rejection, anticipatory bail preferred by him before this Court on 02.12.2022 in A.B.A. No.9266 of 2022.
However, in the meantime, process under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. has been issued on 25.11.2022.
It is apparent that filing of anticipatory bail application before this court was not in the notice of the Court below.

Learned A.P.P. for the State submits that from the execution report, it is apparent that process under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. has been issued after receiving the execution report and there is no infirmity in the order.
Under the circumstance, the impugned order is put in abeyance till the passing of the anticipatory bail application by this Court.
The Criminal Miscellaneous Petition is disposed of.
